title: The Rényi entropy of the order of a random permutation
summary: We study the distribution of the order of a random permutation of $[n]$ through the lens of Rényi entropy. In particular, we obtain an asymptotic for the Rényi $q$-entropy of the order in the full range $1 \leq q \leq \infty$. For $q > 1$, our results are quantitatively optimal and reveal a tight connection between the asymptotic behaviour of the Rényi $q$-entropy and arithmetic properties of $n$.
